display_name: List recorded subscription usage allowance readings
description: iss_c6fbf9ae. Returns every recorded allowance-pool reading, optionally for one profile_id, each with its consumed and remaining percent, as_of, next_reset_at, expires_at, effective_expiry, source, recorded_by and a state of current or expired judged at call time, plus how many are current. A pool with no row here, or only an expired one, reads unknown to select_dispatch_tier, which excludes nothing for an unknown pool. Read-only.
embedding_description: Looking up which subscription plan usage windows currently have a recorded percentage reading, which of those have lapsed, and who recorded each, to learn which readings automated model selection still applies.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: readings (each with profile_id, pool_id, consumed, remaining, as_of, next_reset_at, expires_at, effective_expiry, state current or expired, source, recorded_by, recorded_at), current_readings, as_of.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: List pool by pool with percent consumed and remaining and the time the reading stops counting. Call out every expired reading first; those readings no longer count.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: To keep an exhausted pool excluded, record a fresh reading with record_allowance_pool_reading. A pool with no row is simply unknown and excludes nothing.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One bounded read of the allowance_pool_reading table through the state interface. No writes.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: catalog_invalid: a stored row cannot be parsed. catalog_too_large: the table filled the read page and may be truncated. parameter_invalid: profile_id is blank text. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For catalog_invalid, retract the named pool's reading and record it again. Retry is safe.
